comps.label: C1
comps.reason: AMETEK's electromechanical group makes motors and motion components for OEMs in aerospace, medical and industrial markets, overlapping with Allient.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Crane makes valves, pumps and aerospace sensors; process flow equipment is not motion control or motors.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: ESCO makes filtration, utility test and RF shielding products; it has no meaningful motors or drives.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: ITT's pumps, valves and brake pads are flow and friction components, not precision motors and drives.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Nexteer sells steering and driveline systems only to automakers, unlike Allient's diversified custom motion control for varied OEMs.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Powell builds custom switchgear and power control rooms as projects with services, a different product and revenue model.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: UFP makes medical devices and foam packaging; materials-converting business has no overlap with motion control electronics.
